name: execution_lifecycle
description: Drives the canonical AIOS engineering lifecycle: Understand -> Discover -> Analyze -> Research -> Simulation -> Planning -> Implementation -> Validation -> Testing -> Review -> Documentation -> Completion. Each phase is a gated checkpoint that emits a traceable event before transitioning.

inputs.name: plan
inputs.description: Execution plan produced by the Planner (AIOS-MODULE-000004). If absent, lifecycle pauses at the Planning phase and requests the planner.

outputs.name: execution_report
outputs.description: Report { request_id, phases_completed[], artifacts[], traces[], final_status } — traceable per Engineering Law 13 and Constitution Principle 14.

side_effects: Emits AIOS-EVENT-000002 phase_started and AIOS-EVENT-000003 phase_completed for each phase
Writes execution traces to memory module (AIOS-MODULE-000006)

error_codes.message: A required gate failed for a non-skippable phase.
error_codes.recovery: Hold at the failed phase; run the configured rollback_workflow; report the violated gate to the operator.

error_codes.message: Planner module not installed and lifecycle reached Planning phase.
error_codes.recovery: Pause lifecycle and request planner install, or accept an externally-supplied plan.

examples: Lifecycle transitions are recorded in execution_report.traces as { phase, engine, started_at, completed_at, gate_result }.
